description: Land Acquisition - Hewanathenna, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose (Central Expressway Project), including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, extents, and claimant information. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification criteria.
